scope: Run Flash and Kimi on the hash-selected agreement audit from Wave 2 sentinel tranche 1

effective_limits.interpretation: The agent allows 1200 seconds, while the frozen Switchyard target layer enforces the same 600-second effective call limit used by the sentinel rows.

sandbox_budget.pricing_basis: same Daytona linear resource rates frozen for Gate 8 Wave 1
sandbox_budget.execution_policy: one two-route audit batch; all sandboxes must be Harbor-managed and cleaned after the batch

selection_proof.rule: smallest SHA-256 of agreement seed, task id, and task name

interpretation_guard: This is a predeclared agreement audit, not an outcome-selected disagreement. Keep its missed-contrast evidence separate from contrast-enriched training rows.
